1. Read the red, green and blue values of the pixel.
2. For luminance, decode each value to linear light.
3. Multiply each value by its weight and add them up.
4. For luminance, encode the sum back to sRGB.
5. Write the result to all three channels and round to 8 bits. Keep alpha unchanged.
